senses.gloss:
m. (-कः-का-कं)
Cheerful, not sorrowful.
m. (-कः)
A tree, commonly Aśoka, (Jonesia Asoca.)
n. (-कं)
Quicksilver.
f. (-का)
1 A medicinal plant, see कटुकी.
2 One of the female domestic deities of the Jainas.
E.
अ neg. and शोक sorrow.

f. (-णी)
A medicinal plant, see कटुकी.
E.
अशोक, and रोहिणी the same.

m. (-रिः)
A tree, (Nauclea Cadamba): see कदम्ब.
E.
अशोक, and अरि an enemy: choking the Aśoca.

m. (-चः)
Content, tranquillity, the absence of care or vanity.
E.
अ priv. शोच sorrow.

mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं)
Not to be sorrowed for.
E.
अ neg. शोच्य to be regretted; also अशोचनीय and अशोचितव्य.

n. (-नं)
1 Uncleanness.
2 Inaccuracy.
E.
अ neg. शोधन cleaning, &c.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Unclean, uncleansed.
2 Inaccurate, unrevised, uncorrected.
E.
अ neg. शोधित purified.

mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं)
Not to be dried up.
E.
अ neg. शौष्य to be dried up; so अशोषणीय &c.
